mapper.select:
select id, type, name, name_cn, infobox, nsfw, meta_tags, score, score_details, `rank`, images from bangumi_subject
order by
case when `rank` is null or `rank` <= 0 then 1 else 0 end, case when `rank` is null or `rank` <= 0 then null else `rank` end, id
coalesce(cast(json_unquote(json_extract(favorite, '$.doing')) as unsigned), 0) desc, coalesce(cast(json_unquote(json_extract(favorite, '$.done')) as unsigned), 0) desc, id
(coalesce(cast(json_unquote(json_extract(favorite, '$.wish')) as unsigned), 0) + coalesce(cast(json_unquote(json_extract(favorite, '$.done')) as unsigned), 0) + coalesce(cast(json_unquote(json_extract(favorite, '$.doing')) as unsigned), 0) + coalesce(cast(json_unquote(json_extract(favorite, '$.on_hold')) as unsigned), 0) + coalesce(cast(json_unquote(json_extract(favorite, '$.dropped')) as unsigned), 0)) desc, id
date = '', date desc, id
name asc, id
id
limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select id, type, name, name_cn, infobox, meta_tags, platform, nsfw, score, score_details, `rank`, date, favorite, images from bangumi_subject where type = #{type} and date like concat(#{monthPrefix}, '%') and infobox like '%放送星期%'
and nsfw = 0
order by date asc, id asc

select e.subject_id, e.id, e.name, e.name_cn, e.sort, e.airdate, e.duration from bangumi_episode e join bangumi_subject s on s.id = e.subject_id where s.type = 2 and s.date like concat(#{monthPrefix}, '%') and s.infobox like '%放送星期%' and s.nsfw = 0 and e.type = 0 order by e.subject_id asc, e.sort asc

select id, name, name_cn from bangumi_subject where type = #{type} and (name_cn like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) order by case when name_cn like concat(#{keyword}, '%') then 0 when name like concat(#{keyword}, '%') then 1 when name_cn like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') then 2 else 3 end, `rank` is null, `rank` asc limit #{limit}

select bs.id, bs.type, bs.name, bs.name_cn, bs.infobox, bs.nsfw, bs.score, bs.score_details, bs.`rank`, bs.images, (select uo.access_token from user_oauth uo where uo.user_id = #{userId} and uo.platform = 'bangumi' and uo.status = 1 limit 1) as accessToken, ( case when idx.subject_id = #{exactSubjectId} then 2000 else 0 end + case when idx.name_cn = #{keyword} then 1200 else 0 end + case when idx.name = #{keyword} then 1100 else 0 end + case when = #{compactKeyword} then 1150 else 0 end + case when = #{compactKeyword} then 1050 else 0 end + case when like concat('%', #{compactKeyword}, '%') then 900 else 0 end + case when idx.name_cn like concat(#{keyword}, '%') then 500 else 0 end + case when idx.name like concat(#{keyword}, '%') then 450 else 0 end + case when like concat(#{compactKeyword}, '%') then 620 else 0 end + case when like concat(#{compactKeyword}, '%') then 560 else 0 end + case when idx.aliases like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') then 320 else 0 end + match(idx.name, idx.name_cn, idx.aliases, idx.tags_text, idx.meta_tags_text, idx.search_text) against(#{keyword} in natural language mode) * 100 + case when idx.subject_rank is not null and idx.subject_rank > 0 then greatest(0, 100 - idx.subject_rank / 50) else 0 end + coalesce(idx.score, 0) * 8 + least(idx.favorite_done, 100000) / 2000 ) as relevanceScore from bangumi_subject_search idx join bangumi_subject bs on bs.id = idx.subject_id
order by
relevanceScore desc, idx.favorite_done desc, idx.subject_rank = 0, idx.subject_rank is null, idx.subject_rank, idx.score desc,
relevanceScore desc, idx.subject_rank = 0, idx.subject_rank is null, idx.subject_rank, idx.score desc, idx.favorite_done desc,
relevanceScore desc, idx.score desc, idx.subject_rank = 0, idx.subject_rank is null, idx.subject_rank, idx.favorite_done desc,
relevanceScore desc, idx.subject_rank = 0, idx.subject_rank is null, idx.subject_rank, idx.favorite_done desc,
idx.subject_id limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from bangumi_subject_search idx join bangumi_subject bs on bs.id = idx.subject_id

select r.subject_id, r.relation_type, r.`order`, s.id, s.type, s.name, s.name_cn, s.infobox, s.platform, s.summary, s.nsfw, s.tags, s.meta_tags, s.score, s.score_details, s.`rank`, s.date, s.favorite, s.series, s.images from bangumi_subject_relation r join bangumi_subject s on r.related_subject_id = s.id where r.subject_id = #{subjectId} and s.type = #{type} order by r.`order`, r.related_subject_id

select candidate.id, candidate.type, candidate.name, candidate.name_cn, candidate.infobox, candidate.nsfw, candidate.score, candidate.score_details, candidate.`rank`, candidate.images from ( select s.id, s.type, s.name, s.name_cn, s.infobox, s.nsfw, s.score, s.score_details, s.`rank`, s.`date`, s.images,
coalesce(tag_match.match_count, 0)
0 as tag_matches,
coalesce(meta_tag_match.match_count, 0)
0 as meta_matches from bangumi_subject s
left join ( select subject_id, count(*) as match_count from bangumi_subject_tag where tag_type = 1 and tag_name in
#{tagName}
group by subject_id ) tag_match on tag_match.subject_id = s.id
left join ( select subject_id, count(*) as match_count from bangumi_subject_tag where tag_type = 2 and tag_name in
#{metaTagName}
group by subject_id ) meta_tag_match on meta_tag_match.subject_id = s.id
where s.id != #{subjectId} and s.type = #{type} and s.nsfw = #{nsfw} ) candidate where candidate.tag_matches > 0 or candidate.meta_matches > 0 or (candidate.`rank` is not null and candidate.`rank` > 0) order by ( candidate.tag_matches * 10 + candidate.meta_matches * 6 + case when #{releaseYear} is not null and candidate.`date` regexp '^[0-9]{4}' then greatest(0, 4 - least(4, abs(cast(substring(candidate.`date`, 1, 4) as signed) - #{releaseYear}))) else 0 end + coalesce(candidate.score, 0) + case when candidate.`rank` is not null and candidate.`rank` > 0 then greatest(0, 5 - least(candidate.`rank`, 5000) / 1000) else 0 end ) desc, candidate.`rank` is null, candidate.`rank` = 0, candidate.`rank`, candidate.score desc, candidate.id limit 20
